definitions.gloss: wear and tear; abrasion; wearing down
definitions.explanation: Gradual deterioration of a surface through friction or repeated use. Used for physical objects like tires, brakes, and machinery parts.

examples.japanese: ⟦タイヤ→タイヤ：06330_taiya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{摩耗|まもう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦ブレーキ→ブレーキ：00022_bureeki⟧パッド⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{摩耗|まもう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧。
examples.english: The brake pads are severely worn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{摩耗|まもう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧になった。
examples.english: Years of use wore down the parts and they needed to be replaced.

notes:
A compound of {摩|ま} (to rub, to grind) and {耗|もう} (to wear out, to diminish). Primarily a technical term used for physical wear on materials and machinery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {摩耗|まもう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧ (severely worn)
- {摩耗|まもう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (resistant to wear)
- {摩耗|まもう}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ (wear prevention)
- ⟦タイヤ→タイヤ：06330_taiya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{摩耗|まもう} (tire wear)
- {経年|けいねん}{摩耗|まもう} (wear from aging)

Also written as {磨耗|まもう} with the alternate kanji {磨|ま}. Both writings are common.
